test_devices_add_camera_via_checkbox.title: DEVICES: Add camera to tile using checkbox selection

steps.action: On Views, open the Devices panel, expand the configured site and click All Cameras.
steps.expected: The site's camera thumbnails are listed.

steps.action: Hover the configured camera's thumbnail and tick its checkbox.
steps.expected: An empty tile fills with that camera's video.

test_devices_drag_camera_to_tile.title: A camera thumbnail dragged onto an empty tile starts there

steps.action: On Views > Devices, show the site's cameras.
steps.expected: Camera thumbnails are listed and at least one tile is empty.

steps.action: Drag the first camera thumbnail onto an empty tile.
steps.expected: The tile takes the camera: one fewer empty tile, or a video element shows.

test_my_views_add_saved_view_via_checkbo.title: A saved view ticked in My Views opens

steps.action: Add a tab, rename it, show the site's cameras, tick the first camera and click Save.
steps.expected: The toast View saved successfully shows.

steps.action: Click the My Views tab, hover the saved view and tick its checkbox.
steps.expected: The view opens as a new tab or fills a tile.

test_my_views_drag_saved_view_to_tile.title: MY VIEWS: Drag saved view directly to tile

steps.action: On Views, click the plus tab, rename the new tab, add the first camera with its checkbox, and click Save.
steps.expected: A toast reads View saved successfully.

steps.action: Reload the page and click the My Views subtab.
steps.expected: The saved view is listed by its name.

steps.action: Drag the saved view onto an empty tile.
steps.expected: The tile fills with the view content, or the view opens as a new tab.

test_maps_add_map_via_checkbox.title: MAPS: Add map to tile using checkbox

steps.action: On Views, open the Maps panel and expand the configured site.
steps.expected: The site's map thumbnails are listed.

steps.action: Hover a map thumbnail and tick its checkbox.
steps.expected: An empty tile fills with the map.

test_maps_drag_map_to_tile.title: MAPS: Drag map thumbnail directly to tile

steps.action: On Views, open the Maps panel and expand the configured site.
steps.expected: The site's map thumbnails are listed.

steps.action: Drag a map thumbnail onto an empty tile.
steps.expected: The tile fills with the map.

test_channels_add_channel_via_checkbox.title: CHANNELS: Add channel to tile using checkbox.

steps.action: Log in to the application with valid credentials
steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Navigate to Admin > Channels - Views
steps.expected: Channels - Views page loads without errors

steps.action: Verify the page displays any existing items
steps.expected: Page content loads (list, table, or empty state)

steps.action: Click the create/add button for selecting a channel adds it to the grid
steps.expected: Creation form or dialog opens

steps.action: Verify all required form fields are present and empty/default
steps.expected: Form fields are displayed with correct labels and placeholders

steps.action: Fill in all required fields with valid test data
steps.expected: All fields accept the input without errors

steps.action: Fill in any optional fields if applicable
steps.expected: Optional fields accept input

steps.action: Review the filled form for correctness
steps.expected: All entered data is displayed correctly in the form

steps.action: Click the Save/Submit/Create button
steps.expected: Form is submitted and a success message or indicator appears

steps.action: Verify the newly created selecting a channel adds it to the grid appears in the list or view
steps.expected: The new selecting a channel adds it to the grid is visible with the correct data

steps.action: Verify no duplicate entries were created
steps.expected: Only one instance of the new selecting a channel adds it to the grid exists

test_channels_drag_channel_to_tile.title: Verify a channel dragged onto an empty tile starts there

steps.action: On Views, click the Channels subtab.
steps.expected: The panel lists the tenant's channels. With none the test skips naming that.

steps.action: Drag the first channel onto an empty tile.
steps.expected: The tile takes the channel: one fewer empty tile, or a video element shows.

test_insights_add_via_checkbox.title: INSIGHTS: Add insight widget to tile using checkbox

steps.action: Create an insight widget, then on Views open the Insights panel.
steps.expected: The widget's card is listed in the panel.

steps.action: Hover the widget card and tick its checkbox.
steps.expected: An empty tile fills with the widget (on the current build the card offers no checkbox and drag is the add path, so the automated check stops there).
